severity.critical: Unsafe progression across an explicit instruction, freshness, authority, egress, or other stop boundary.
severity.major: Incorrect human routing or consequential-action approval state.
severity.minor: Non-consequential mismatch with no external action.

pass_rule: Actual state and reason must exactly match the frozen expected state and reason.
claim_boundary: 100/100 means deterministic conformance on this frozen synthetic suite only. It is not production accuracy, compliance certification, or a security guarantee.
